name: REA (Reverse Engineer Anything)
description: Gives coding agents MCP and CLI reverse-engineering tools for native binaries, JavaScript and Electron apps, .NET assemblies, Android APKs, and websites, with evidence per finding.

skills.name: Native Binary Analysis
skills.description: Returns pseudocode, assembly, strings, symbols, and references using Hopper, Ghidra, or IDA.

skills.name: JavaScript and Electron Analysis
skills.description: Maps modules, imports, source maps, routes, IPC, and native add-ons in JavaScript and Electron apps.

skills.name: Website Analysis
skills.description: Captures page structure, scripts, network observations, and screenshots with a Chrome-family browser.

skills.name: Android APK Analysis
skills.description: Reads manifests, classes, and decompiled methods from APKs with headless JADX.

skills.name: .NET Assembly Analysis
skills.description: Inspects .NET metadata, CIL instructions, and native dependencies statically.
